ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: Predominantly low-intensity (dark) surface with a high-intensity (white) pixel distribution ratio of approximately 0.15, primarily localized at the distal tips and within medial mottling zones.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Contiguous high-intensity pixel clusters localized at the extreme distal tips of both lobes. High-contrast white circular rings (3-8 pixel diameter) scattered on the right lobe. Grey-scale mottled pixels concentrated in the lower-medial region of the left lobe.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Acute V-shaped central depression with a calculated interior angle of approximately 48 degrees.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: High-frequency, irregular serrations along the trailing boundary with vertical amplitude variations ranging from 2 to 10 pixels. Significant jagged indentations present on the inner-medial section of the left lobe.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Bi-lateral concave sweep trajectory curving from the median notch upward toward the distal tips.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: Visible high-contrast white ring-shaped clusters on the mid-right lobe. Dense, irregular high-intensity clusters (barnacle colonization) at the far lateral margins of both lobes.
localized_surface_anomalies.linear_abrasions: Distinct horizontal high-intensity linear disruption (scratch) on the mid-section of the right lobe; shorter, fainter diagonal disruptions on the lower-left lobe medial area.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Extensive barnacle encrustation on the wingtips. Multiple circular 'halo' scars on the right lobe pigmentation consistent with past ectoparasite attachment sites.
other_distinctive_markers: Pronounced jagged-edge 'chip' or deep serration on the left lobe trailing edge approximately 30% of the distance from the median notch to the tip.
